resources.name: Pinside
resources.description: A large online community where collectors and players discuss machines, share tips, and post reviews. Covers a broad range of manufacturers and eras.

resources.name: Tilt Forums
resources.description: Community forum focused on pinball discussion, rules breakdowns, and repair guides across a wide range of titles.

resources.name: IPDB
resources.description: The Internet Pinball Machine Database — a volunteer-maintained encyclopedia of pinball machines dating from the earliest electromechanical era to modern solid-state titles. Covers serial numbers, production counts, and historical notes.

resources.name: OPDB
resources.description: The Open Pinball Database — a community-maintained registry of pinball machines with canonical identifiers, manufacturer records, and edition data. Used by operators and collectors as a reference catalog.

resources.name: Pinside Pulse
resources.description: Pinside's machine directory with community ratings, owner counts, and user-contributed game information for a broad library of titles.

resources.name: American Pinball
resources.description: Official site for American Pinball — manufacturer support, game pages, and news directly from the manufacturer.

resources.name: Barrels of Fun (Spooky)
resources.description: Official site for Spooky Pinball (a Barrels of Fun brand) — game information, support resources, and manufacturer news.

resources.name: Chicago Gaming Company
resources.description: Official site for Chicago Gaming Company — game pages and manufacturer information for their coin-op lineup.

resources.name: Jersey Jack Pinball
resources.description: Official site for Jersey Jack Pinball — game details, support, and news directly from the manufacturer.

resources.name: Multimorphic
resources.description: Official site for Multimorphic — modular P3 platform game pages and developer resources.

resources.name: Stern Pinball
resources.description: Official site for Stern Pinball — game pages, service bulletins, manuals, and manufacturer support.

resources.name: eBay Pinball Listings
resources.description: eBay's pinball machine category — a broad secondary market with listings from individual sellers and dealers. Prices vary widely; verify condition and shipping costs carefully.

resources.name: Facebook Marketplace
resources.description: Local and national pinball machine listings on Facebook Marketplace. Useful for finding machines nearby and negotiating directly with sellers.

resources.name: Mr. Pinball
resources.description: A long-running pinball classifieds site with both dealer and private-party listings. Covers new, used, and restored machines.

resources.name: Pinside Market
resources.description: Pinside's buy/sell section for pinball machines and parts, with listings from community members. Covers a broad range of titles and conditions.

resources.name: Pinball News
resources.description: Coverage of pinball industry news, game announcements, and show reports from a collector-focused perspective.

resources.name: IFPA
resources.description: The International Flipper Pinball Association — the governing body for competitive pinball. Hosts player rankings, tournament calendars, and official rules.

resources.name: Match Play Events
resources.description: Tournament management platform used by organizers worldwide. Browse upcoming events and results, or run your own bracket.

resources.name: Pinball Map
resources.description: A community-maintained map of publicly accessible pinball machines at arcades, bars, and venues. Useful for finding a specific title to play near you.
